description: Takes a travel expense list (employee, start and end date, hours away for one-day trips, destination as country or city, km, vehicle, claimed meals, travel and hotel, receipt yes or no, meals provided such as "2 breakfasts") and checks every trip against the official rates as of 1 January 2026: meals in Germany 14 euros (more than 8 hours, arrival and departure day) and 28 euros (24 hours) under section 9 (4a) EStG, cut by 20 % per breakfast and 40 % per lunch or dinner provided; mileage 0.30 euros per km by car and 0.20 euros by other motor vehicles; overnight without receipt 20 euros in Germany; abroad the country and city rates of the German Federal Ministry of Finance letter of 5 December 2025 (all 214 entries built in, countries not listed use the Luxembourg rate). Also flags trips submitted twice, overlapping trips of the same person, missing receipts and weekend trips. Returns red and yellow findings per trip, claimed versus allowed per person and in total. Without a list, a destination returns its rates. Rates are fixed in the tool with source and date, nothing is fetched. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

destination.description: Without trips: a country or city whose rates to show, for example "Milan" or "Denmark".

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

trips.description: Rows: employee, start, end, hours, destination (or country and city), km, vehicle, meals_claimed, travel_claimed, hotel_claimed, nights, receipt, meals_provided. German column names work too.

name: check_expenses
title: Expense checker: travel expense claims against the official German per diem, mileage and overnight rates, with double submissions, overlaps, missing receipts and weekends
